deployments_detail.use: Stated intent to adopt data/behavioral analytics and AI to improve online services via digital-banking vendor Kony; independent benchmark rates CFG Bank AI maturity as low - no production AI system disclosed

Virtual assistant / chatbot on the website and mobile app answering customer product and account-opening questions 24/7, described as a channel that 'learns every day' and is continuously enriched. [not disclosed]

Automatic pre-categorization of income and expenses in the mobile app (personal financial management), classifying identifiable transactions into spending categories with analytics/charts of spending habits. [built on Kony DBX / Temenos Digital Banking platform]
Announced intent (with digital-banking vendor Kony) to adopt artificial intelligence, data analysis and behavioral analysis to improve the online customer experience. [Kony]

Plan to pair artificial intelligence with data analytics and consumer behavior analysis to predict and assist decision-making for client and bank (stated by Retail Executive Director Moulhim Aouad; described in the Temenos success story as not yet in production). [Temenos (Kony DBX)]

Facial biometric identity verification (selfie-based) during 100% digital remote account opening via the 'Be CFG Bank' app, confirming the customer's identity with biometric technology. [not disclosed]
Automated ID-document authenticity check from a photo of the identity document during remote onboarding in the 'Be CFG Bank' app (part of the eKYC flow). [not disclosed]
